text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Bank of Portugal could cut official rates again before the end of this year, analysts said.

- Asked if Portugal's membership of the European single currency would mean changes for the central bank, Bank of Portugal governor Antonio de Sousa told the paper: "The Bank of Portugal will be very similar to what it is today."
- Portuguese insurance premiums rose 19.7 percent to 645 billion escudos from January to October, compared with the same year-ago period.
- Credit Lyonnais considers the possibility of leaving Portugal, the paper learned.

- Portugal's budget deficit rose 20.2 percent to 436 billion escudos from January to October, compared with the same year-ago period, mainly due to the timing of a funds transfer, the finance ministry said.
